items.html: *And it has also been explained that in the first pregnancy he is in the secret of VAK, only they are doubled, these in those — three included in three — for only the three lower ones were revealed in them. And in the nursing, complete VAK were revealed and expanded, and they expanded from what they were at first — included and concealed only three within three. And in the second pregnancy, also the GAR, called the Mochin, were revealed in him, and then he is complete, in complete ten Sefirot.
